children: Accent Group's longer-term potential isn't enough to offset concerns at Morgans about the footwear and apparel retailer's slowing sales. Lowering her recommendation to hold from accumulate, analyst Emily Porter tells clients in a note that the current share price undervalues the potential she sees in the business. However, she warns that there are limited reasons for the stock to re-rate any time soon. Porter says Accent's latest update shows trading is weak, with sales moderating over the last 12 weeks. Morgans cuts its target price 12% to 0.68 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.4% at A$0.6525. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
